summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 23, 2026, reporting its 2026 Governance Report to the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM). The report describes the company's adherence to the Brazilian Corporate Governance Code, its migration to B3's Novo Mercado segment in June 2026, and adoption of 'one share, one vote' while preserving a golden share held by the Brazilian Federal Government. Board composition and evaluation practices are detailed. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate restructuring is involved. The filing is an ordinary update on governance practices, not triggering any special-situations category.
